create_report_pdf: create a PDF report with executive summary, key challenges, open questions, and visualization graphs for a GitHub repository
ReportPDF_init: initialize a ReportPDF object with a repository name and date range for generating an AutoTriage PDF report
add_challenge: add a challenge entry with key challenge title, possible causes, remediations, and linked affected GitHub issues to the PDF
add_graphs_section: add a visualization section with a title and list of plot image paths to the PDF report
challenges_section: add a key challenges section to the PDF report by iterating over a list of challenge data dictionaries
